analysis:
Integration pass over all 37 units. The PR is mostly docs, tests and benchmark tooling, plus a small production change: Gemma 4 prefill geometry (2048-token chunk / 4096-token step) in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift and the ProductionBuild.prefillGeometry field. It also adds env knobs DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS, forwarded through the LaunchAgent passthrough allowlist, and a .toolCallDelta event case.

No confidentiality, attestation, authorization, key-custody or coordinator-wire change is visible.

The new env knobs are non-secret numeric tuning values set by the local operator, who is already inside TB-003. Parsing falls back to SDK defaults on malformed, zero or negative input. There is no upper clamp, but the worst case is the operator's own OOM or DoS, which is not a cross-boundary regression (T-010/T-029 class). Gemma 4 media keeps a 512 chunk ceiling. The paged pool is sized from max(chunk, stripe), which the docs and tests (EngineV2PrefillGeometryTests, EngineV2KVBackendGateTests) pin as unchanged. The measured 3.73 GiB peak is inside the 5.5 GiB reserve. GPT-OSS and Qwen3.5-9B keep the old geometry because the wide one would exceed their floors. This is a documented, pre-existing headroom gap.

T-041 prefix-cache surfaces (SSD tier, HMAC names, TTL, salt scoping) are untouched. The overrides enter the complete-checkpoint numerics fingerprint per the docs, but PrefixCachePolicy was not supplied, so that is unverified.

FlintResponseFormat.swift line 114 ignores .toolCallDelta, so it is not added to the validated content. This is consistent with the existing fail-closed behavior.

Open items for further review, none established as findings:
- The upstream libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule bump (889fe3c -> f77b384) is opaque and may introduce .toolCallDelta streaming. Confirm that streamed tool-call deltas are validated before emission (forced tool_choice, response_format) and are encrypted on the fail-closed response path (T-008).
- Confirm the response-hash encoding for OpenAIToolCallDelta stays equivalent (ProviderLoop+SSEParser).
- The integration replay omitted 177 units, so coverage of the production sources is incomplete.
